# Municipal Ordinance No. 003 (Second), Series of 2013

**A Resolution Augmenting the Amount of P354,375.05 from the Savings/Unexpended Appropriations from January to May 2013 Under the Personal Services of Various Vacant Positions to RATA**

Resolution No. 057

## Summary

Augments **P354,375.05** from savings/unexpended appropriations from January to May 2013 under the Personal Services of various vacant positions to cover Representation and Transportation Allowance (RATA) for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. References Local Budget Circular No. 103 dated May 15, 2013, on RATA guidelines.

Absent: [[Kenneth Earl T. Budao]] (PPSK, on privilege leave).

## Key Provisions

- **Amount Augmented:** P354,375.05
- **Source of Funds:** Savings/unexpended appropriations from Personal Services of various vacant positions (January to May 2013)
- **Purpose:** Cover Representation and Transportation Allowance (RATA)
- **Legal Reference:** Local Budget Circular No. 103, dated May 15, 2013 (RATA guidelines)

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Dante L. Punac Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
